name: Price differs by rating (Kruskal-Wallis)
H0: Price distribution is the same for every rating
verdict: Fail to reject H0 (no evidence of an effect)

name: Price vs rating association (Spearman)
H0: No monotonic association between price and rating (rho = 0)
verdict: Fail to reject H0 (no evidence of an effect)

name: Price differs by category (Kruskal-Wallis)
H0: Price distribution is the same in every category
verdict: Fail to reject H0 (no evidence of an effect)

name: Price differs by stock status (Mann-Whitney U)
H0: Price distribution is the same for in-stock and out-of-stock books
note: SKIPPED: smaller group has only 0 rows

name: Rating vs stock status (chi-square)
H0: Rating and stock status are independent

name: Description length vs price (Spearman)
H0: No monotonic association between description length and price
verdict: Fail to reject H0 (no evidence of an effect)

name: Ratings are balanced (chi-square goodness-of-fit)
H0: All five ratings are equally common
verdict: Fail to reject H0 (no evidence of an effect)
